# Unlock your stay with the Hilton Honors app

Plan, book, and manage every part of your stay in one place

Choose your room before you arrive, check in digitally, chat with your hotel, and use Digital Key to go straight to your room. Not a Member?

Join Hilton Honors for free

Download the app

## Before you arrive

Everything you need before you arrive is in the app. Manage your Hilton Honors account, plan your stay, and get ready for your visit in just a few taps.

## Book, explore, and more

Track your Hilton Honors Points and progress at a glance, search for hotels, compare rates, and save your favorites. Book direct in the app for the best available rate, access exclusive offers, and manage your stays – all in one place.

## Smart pre-stay features

Choose your room in advance using the hotel map, check in online the day before your stay, and skip the front desk if you prefer. Explore available hotel services and discover things to do before you arrive.

## During your stay

While you're here, use the app to personalize your stay, connect with the hotel team, and access time-saving features.

## Digital Key and online check-out

Go straight to your room with Digital Key – just open the Hilton Honors app and unlock the door from your phone. When you're ready to leave, check out online and head to your next destination. Need a ride? Request a Lyft through the app (US & Canada only).

## Your stay, your way

Make the most of your stay right from the app. Chat with your hotel anytime for questions, amenity requests, or local recommendations. Plus, connect to your room’s TV and stream your favorite music and entertainment using the in‑app virtual remote.

The convenience continues after departure, with the app providing an easy way to review account activity, track Hilton Honors Points and monitor progress toward the next elite tier.

For many travelers, the end of one trip often marks the beginning of planning the next. By bringing dreaming, booking, staying and rewards together in one convenient experience, the Hilton Honors App helps members stay connected throughout every part of their travel journey while making it easier to get more out of every stay. Hilton Honors is free to join, and the Hilton Honors App is available as a free download for iOS and Android devices.

##### FAQ: Smarter Stays Start Here: Inside the Hilton Honors App

##### What is the Hilton Honors App?

The Hilton Honors App is a trusted travel companion that helps Hilton Honors members discover destinations, book stays and manage their Points. The app allows members to enjoy a more seamless experience before, during and after their stay.

##### Is the Hilton Honors app free?

Yes. The Hilton Honors program is free to join, and the Hilton Honors App is available as a free download for iOS and Android devices.

##### How does the Hilton Honors App help with trip planning?

The app lets members search, book and manage upcoming stays across Hilton’s global portfolio, while keeping Hilton Honors benefits and Points balances within easy reach. Members can also access exclusive rates, special offers and promotions. Before their stay, members can access hotel information, connect with hotel team members, make restaurant reservations and more. 

##### How do Hilton Honors members manage their Points in the app?

The app serves as a hub for members to track, manage and redeem Hilton Honors Points as they plan future stays.

##### How does the Hilton Honors App simplify arrival at a hotel?

Before reaching the property, members can chat with the hotel, check-in through the app, choose their room using an interactive hotel map and unlock the door using Digital Key at available properties.

## Getting started with Alexa for Shopping

Alexa for Shopping will roll out to all U.S. customers over the coming week. To get started, update your Amazon Shopping app and tap the Alexa icon in the bottom navigation bar, or find it at the top of your screen on desktop.

All Amazon customers can use Alexa for Shopping for free when signed into their account, no Echo device, Alexa app, or Prime membership required.

## Key takeaways

  * Lens Live instantly scans products and shows real-time matches in a swipeable carousel to make finding the right item easier.
  * Lens Live integrates Amazon’s AI shopping assistant, Alexa for Shopping, to offer product insights, summaries, and answer questions as you browse.
  * It is now available for customers in the Amazon Shopping app on iOS and Android.

* * *

When you spot an item you love on social media or while out and about, Amazon Lens is the quickest way to find similar items in the Amazon Shopping app. Now, we’re making Amazon Lens even better with the introduction of Lens Live, powered by AI, to make the experience even easier and more useful.
And, in cases where Lens can't identify exact or similar products in an image, we've introduced intelligent captions that describe what's visible in the scene and provide clarifying descriptions. To ask any additional questions, customers can tap on the “Ask about this” bar under the product carousel and type in any question they have about the product like, “How do I remove this coffee stain from my rug?” to get a response and continue the conversation with Alexa for Shopping.

Amazon Lens Live is now available for tens of millions of U.S. customers in the Amazon Shopping app on iOS and Android. Customers can still use traditional Lens options (taking a picture, uploading an image, or scanning a barcode) if they prefer.

## International considerations

If you are using a URL for linking, you might need to implement some logic to handle different sites, such as international sites, to reference the proper Amazon domain. For example, for the US, a link such as: http://www.amazon.com/gp/mas/dl/android?p=com.example.myapp.apk will work in the US, but not in France.

In France, the equivalent link might be: http://www.amazon.fr/gp/mas/dl/android?p=com.example.myapp.apk.
